entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with long light-colored hair, wearing a beige patterned short-sleeved top and a long white skirt, sitting barefoot slightly left of center on the Dirt Road.

entities.name: Dilapidated White Wooden House
entities.identification: The grayish-white horizontal-plank wooden house in the center background, with a triangular gable, a damaged roof, and a porch on the left.

entities.name: Dirt Road
entities.identification: The broad grayish-brown bare ground occupying the lower foreground and extending to the area in front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Grayish-White Sky
entities.identification: The bright Grayish-White Sky in the upper part of the valid image area, behind the roof and tree branches, with a slight pale-blue tint.

entities.name: Weeds on Both Sides of the Road
entities.identification: Patches of green grass and withered yellow plants distributed along the left and right edges of the road.

entities.name: Dead Tree on the Image-Left
entities.identification: The slender grayish-brown trunk and leafless branches near the image-left edge, to the left of the main wooden house, with the upper end extending out of frame.

entities.name: Distant Wooden Shed on the Image-Right
entities.identification: The low, crooked grayish-brown wooden shed in the distant background to the right of the main wooden house, with a low-pitched roof and dark openings.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with short dark hair, wearing a light-blue short-sleeved collared top, brown trousers, and dark-brown shoes, bending forward and crouching on the image-right side of Person A.
